source.claim: 300+ waterfalls is a regional total estimate, not the number of source-access-verified listed visitor routes.
source.coverage: Only the first 12 waterfall/listing directory cards visible in an independently indexed main-page search excerpt, plus UP Travel's separate complete 11-name western featured article. This is NOT an exhaustive export of the dynamically rendered directory.
source.addressWarning: Tourist-listing street and municipality labels are not GPS, validated driveway access, public parking sites, pedestrian-rights proof or live opening status.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Abinodji Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Named waterfall; historic county-road label not verified trailhead.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Ajibikoka Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Backcountry falls; street label is not safe arrival or parking.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Alder Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Existing source review says unmarked sand-road approach lacks verified legal public waterfall trailhead.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Alger Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.addressLabel: Jct Of State Highway M28 & M94
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Adopted city/county planning records no safe parking at highway; do not copy listed intersection as stop.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Au Train Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Historic recreational directions superseded by changed ownership and 2026 EGLE dam order; no approved waterfall approach.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Bathtub Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.addressLabel: M-64 N and S Boundary Rd

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Big Eric's Falls

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Big Pup Creek Falls
mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.note: Potential separate Big Pup feature, river access/parking and correct natural point not yet cleared.

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Black River Falls

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.addressLabel: Black River National Forest Scenic Byway

mainDirectoryFirstTwelve.name: Bond Falls Scenic Site

policies: No town-label-to-precise-GPS geocoding or road-entrance inference.
No route navigation based on tourism addresses, informal field reports or coordinates of the cascade.
Keep source-only candidates out of published recommendation, parking, nearby, itemlist and sitemap.
Do not treat the 104 indexed tourism directory listing-count estimate as 104 separately verified falls, or assume the 300+ estimate is an accessible source table.
